customManagers.description: DEPS_BASE of mcf-build.yml. Looked up on Docker Hub, the source nora proxies: Renovate has no docker credentials for nora. So the 3-day hold of externalImages applies, and a digest move is a PR for a person.

packageRules.description: DEPS_BASE keeps the Node major of the node-version input of mcf-build.yml; the workflow fails when they differ.

Every external action in this repo is referenced by its version tag (`@vX.Y.Z`), never by a commit sha: no digests are pinned, Renovate bumps the tag. Weekly (the rule at the end of this list) and in the daily preset's branches because these workflows are a shared library — one PR a week is one review and one release tag, instead of a dozen tags nobody reads. `separateMajorMinor: false` is what makes it literally one PR -- config:recommended would otherwise split majors into a second branch. Flip it back to true if a stuck major (setup-python v7, configure-aws-credentials v6 are waiting) starts holding the routine bumps hostage.

ansible-lint / yamllint in ansible/requirements-lint.txt are `==` pins consumed only by collection-lint.yml. Same weekly window, own PR: a linter bump can turn the lint job red on code nobody touched, and that must not be bisected out of an actions group.

Never let a dependency PR cut anything but a patch tag. release.yml derives the bump from Conventional Commits (ci/next-version.sh): `feat:` is a minor and `!`/BREAKING CHANGE is a major, and consumers pin `vX`. `chore(deps)` keeps every automated bump on the patch line.

Keep this repo's own cadence: the daily preset groups the updates into renovate/daily and renovate/daily-review, this rule (after the preset's rules) puts its schedule back. Weekly, Monday 00:00-06:59 in this repo's timezone (Europe/Lisbon), the window the github-actions and ansible-lint rules already had: these workflows are a shared library, one review and one release tag a week.

ansible-galaxy.description: Left at its default (enabled, nothing to match). The collection here is a PUBLISHER — ansible/collections/maestra/infra/galaxy.yml — not a consumer: there is no requirements.yml in the repo, so this manager finds no files. Recorded so the next reader does not have to re-derive it.
